what_it_enables: Rigorous diagnostic segregation: clear distinction between Engine Problems and Game Problems

64-snapshot time-travel state rewind, event triggers, and deterministic FNV-1a state hashing
Hardware-style invariant tripwire matrix and safe degradation fallbacks without crude crashes
Zero-heap serialization across fixed-column plaintext, NDJSON streams, CSV tables, and replays
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations across all diagnostic routines (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Non-crashing tripwire traps and safe state restoration
Universal 5-Block Lifecycle Protocol enforced across all definitions
